name: VaultSpec
description: VaultSpec names who a vault belongs to and holds its entries.

fields.name: Person
fields.description: The person whose My vault this is, by identity account id.

fields.name: Org
fields.description: The organization a shared vault belongs to, by id.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description:
Your own identifier for this vault, unique within the organization.

 An integrator that keeps one vault per customer sets it to the
 customer's id and finds the vault again with getByExternalId. Shared
 vaults only.

fields.name: Secrets
fields.description:
Secrets by name. A secret fills the requirement with the same name, such
 as OPENAI_API_KEY.

fields.name: Connections
fields.description:
Connections by address. A pasted login or a sign-in fills the login of
 every HTTP tool at that address, whose requests carry the token there,
 or clones from a Git host such as github.com.
